description: Risk, reliability, safety, and assurance analysis often relies on specialist diagrams that are difficult to build and maintain directly in Power BI. Ataytis Assurance brings six structured analysis methods into one interactive visual, allowing report creators to generate diagrams directly from their data instead of maintaining separate static drawings. It is designed for teams that need to communicate risk, failure, reliability, assurance, and system-state information inside Power BI while keeping diagrams connected to the same filters, measures, operational data, and reporting context as the rest of the report. Why Ataytis Assurance? Key features: Six analysis modes in one visual: Fault Tree Analysis (FTA), Bow-Tie Risk Analysis, Event Tree Analysis (ETA), Reliability Block Diagrams (RBD), Goal Structuring Notation (GSN), and Markov state-transition diagrams. Data-driven diagram generation from Power BI fields, so diagrams can update automatically as report filters, slicers, sites, scenarios, systems, products, or other dimensions change. Fault Tree Analysis with events, logic gates, voting gates, inhibit and priority logic, transfer relationships, repeated events, probability data, branch focus, validation, and support for IEC 61025 notation. Bow-Tie Risk Analysis with hazards, threats, preventive barriers, top events, mitigative barriers, consequences, escalation factors,…
